description: Election Commission - E. Mary Allen was selected as the Member of the Velanai P/S - Z. M. Rafi was selected as the Member of Eravur Pattu P/S - S. Chandrasekaran was selected as the member of the Vavuniya South (Tamil) P/S
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
